name: CHEK
tickerNote: Brand is CHEK. CHEKD is only the token symbol (owner decision, 01 Oct 2026 UTC — $CHEK was crowded with unrelated tokens).
oneLiner: A Solana meme coin with one rule: every claim comes with a receipt.

platform.name: Pump.fun
platform.note: Platform values change. Re-check on launch day; after the mint we publish the real creation transaction and its real cost.

drop.name: CHEK Receipt Drop
drop.source: the creator wallet’s own launch buy (bought on the curve like everyone; free allocation stays 0%)
drop.entry: subscribe to t.me/chekcoinsol and leave your public Solana address in the comments under the drop post (or send it to @chekcoinsol_bot) — one address per Telegram account
drop.x: follow @chekcoinsol and repost the drop post (asked, not verifiable)
drop.draw_rules: 24 hours after launch; draw winners picked at random with a published Solana blockhash as the seed, anyone can re-check
drop.send: from the creator wallet within 48 hours after the draw; every transfer published as an on-chain receipt
drop.condition: only if $CHEKD launches; airdrop for the first 500 valid entries, draw among all valid entries
drop.never: no claim site, no wallet connect, no signing, no fees, no DMs from us
